broker.name: Axi
broker.tagline: On its own site since 2007. Its site names 6 regulators, including ASIC, FMA, and FCA. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:1000.
broker.about: Axi says it has operated since 2007. The pages checked do not name one headquarters. Account names on its site include Standard and Pro. Platforms named there include Axi trading app, MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, and Axi Copy Trading. The site names these regulators: ASIC, FMA, FCA, CySEC, DFSA, and FSA (St Vincent). The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:1000. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.

broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. ASIC: AxiCorp Financial Services Pty Ltd, 318232. FMA: AxiCorp Financial Services Pty Ltd, 518226. plans.name: Standard
plans.billing_note: Setup free. No commission. Min trade 0.01 lots. Help table: margin/leverage up to 1000:1. EURUSD from 0.68 pips. Gold from $0.16. BTCUSD from $12 per lot and ETHUSD from $1.25 per lot, no handling fee. Platforms MT4 and MT5.

plans.name: Pro
plans.billing_note: Setup free. Commission $4.50 round trip. Min trade 0.01 lots. Help table: margin/leverage up to 1000:1. EURUSD from 0.0 pips. Gold from $0.09. Same crypto spread line as Standard.

leverage.market: Standard and Pro accounts (global help table)
leverage.note: Help article updated about 28 days before this research. Not stated as available in every jurisdiction.
ASIC/FMA help article: for retail accounts under the ASIC/FMA licence the maximum leverage is 30:1.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: No single minimum. Global help says the minimum deposit varies by payment method, and recommends funding at least USD 200 to cover margin. The same help centre says Standard and Pro have a recommended minimum deposit of USD 100. The homepage funded-trader section says deposit from $500 to get started, which is for that program.
